runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Ginger Scallion Noodles, Bún Chả, Plum and Almond Frangipane Tart
runs.content:
1. Ginger Scallion Noodles with Crispy Chilli Oil — inspired by David Chang. A 20-minute Momofuku pantry classic: spring onion, ginger, and hot oil doing all the work.
2. Bún Chả (Vietnamese Grilled Pork with Noodles) — inspired by Anthony Bourdain. The Hanoi dish he shared with Obama — grilled pork, herbs, and a sharp nuoc cham dipping sauce.
3. Plum and Almond Frangipane Tart — inspired by Nigel Slater. The wild card: a weekend bake built around early-August plums at their sharp-sweet best.

runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Seared Trout with Brown Butter & Capers, Momofuku-Style Pork and Miso Ramen, The Perfect French Omelette
runs.content:
1. Seared Trout with Brown Butter, Capers and Green Beans — inspired by Nigel Slater. A fast, 25-minute weeknight supper built on one good piece of fish and a simple brown butter sauce.
2. Momofuku-Style Pork and Miso Ramen — inspired by David Chang. A weekend technique project: slow-poached pork, a miso-tare broth, and soft-cooked ramen eggs.
3. The Perfect French Omelette (Bourdain's Kitchen Confidential Test) — inspired by Anthony Bourdain. The wild card: the plain omelette he used to judge a cook's real skill, ready in 10 minutes.
